scope: Leto v1 formulation and utility loop; agent/task distribution in its evaluated settings
statement: Leto defines task-relative memory utility as the outcome difference with versus without served memory; its per-memory index is updated from shared response outcomes and is not an estimate of each memory item’s individual causal contribution.

EvoDisco’s immediate transformation score uses the change in retrieval quality on cached prior queries minus a graph-complexity penalty; the paper distinguishes this local surrogate from the population task-score objective.

scope: LEDGER v1 policy and evaluated coding-agent setting
statement: LEDGER uses explicit source ranking and valid-time records to determine current values, but its source hierarchy depends on stated reliability assumptions and is not presented as a universal source order.
